## Release — backlog-campaign v0.27.1

### ✨ New in v0.27.1

#### `bun run status` groups blocked items like the dashboard

- The text status no longer lists every blocked item on its own line. Items waiting on you each keep a line, so they are never folded away. Everything else is grouped by reason (another agent's lane, tracking issue, dependency, sequenced phase, merge conflict, overlap), one line each with a count and the first few issue numbers ([#1132](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1132)).
- On a real campaign, the Blocked section goes from 54 lines to 9.
- The text status, the HTML page and the campaign dashboard now group with the same rules, so their counts always agree.
